title: Word-level alignment of one surah file
description: timing-data-nemo/<reciter>/<NNN>.json. One audio file (normally one surah) of one reciter.

reciter.description: Directory/recitation id. For mp3quran.net reciters this is mp3quran's server slug (trablsi…) inside the file; the directory is the app id (mp3quran_201_199…).

surahs_present.description: More than one when a file holds two surahs (e.g. 085 = البروج then الطارق).

alternate_source.description: This surah is a separate recording filling a gap in the reciter's khatma.

chunk_window.description: Seconds per recognition window used (10.5 or 20).

word.description: The word as written in the reference text (مصحف الأوقاف الليبية, رواية قالون).

location.description: surah:ayah:word, all 1-based, Qalun numbering (6,214 ayahs). Basmala/Isti'adha/Tahmeed words use the sentinel 0:0:N.

start.description: Seconds, RELATIVE to the segment's time_from. absolute = time_from + start. Quantised to 0.08 s (the model's frame stride).

end.description: Seconds, relative to time_from. The last word may run past the segment's time_to: real, do not clamp.

time_from.description: Absolute seconds into the audio file.

time_to.description: Absolute seconds into the audio file.

ref_from.description: surah:ayah:word, or "" / null when the segment is not Quran text.

ref_to.description: surah:ayah:word, or "" / null when the segment is not Quran text.

words.description: May be empty: the segment is placed on text the aligner had already used up.

segment.description: 1-based order of the segment in the file.

error.description: e.g. "Low confidence (0%)" or "Dropped: isolated match on surah N …".

repeated_ranges.description: Ranges the reciter read again (takrar), as [from, to] locations.

gap.description: A segment added by the gap filler (fill_gaps.py) for words the first pass missed. NOTE: it has no segment, has_missing_words, has_repeated_words, special_type or error keys.

time_from.description: Absolute seconds into the audio file.

time_to.description: Absolute seconds into the audio file.

ref_from.description: surah:ayah:word, or "" / null when the segment is not Quran text.

ref_to.description: surah:ayah:word, or "" / null when the segment is not Quran text.

words.description: May be empty: the segment is placed on text the aligner had already used up.

fill_check.description: verified: the filled words were confirmed by a second recognition of that stretch.
